observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

observation.setting: Indoor stage with a large projection screen in the background showing a village scene, theatrical lighting with blue and green spots
observation.dancers: Group of mixed male and female dancers, approximately 10 performers
observation.formation_and_space: Dancers start in a line across the stage, occasionally pairing up and moving in coordinated steps across the stage
observation.posture: Upright torso, slightly bent knees with soft weight changes
observation.footwork: Shuffling and stepping pattern moving laterally and forward in time with the music; precise footwork obscured by distance and low frame rate
observation.arms_and_hands: Arms held horizontally or curved at waist/shoulder level, wrists flexing and hands gesturing gently
observation.hips_and_torso: Minimal hip movement, torso remains upright with gentle upper body sways
observation.partnering: Occasional pairing without close physical contact, moving in parallel or facing each other
observation.levels_jumps_turns: Low level changes with occasional kneeling, smooth turns on the spot and traveling
observation.costume_and_props: Traditional-style attire with colorful tunics, sarongs, and headwear for both men and women
observation.cannot_infer: Exact footwork details and weight transfers are obscured by video resolution and distance from the stage.

signature_moments.what: Dancers enter the stage from the sides in a line with low-level stepping and sweeping arm gestures
Dancers sink into a low kneeling position while extending arms gracefully to the sides
Group forms a line and steps rhythmically side-to-side with coordinated wrist and hand rotations
